title: ひと息ソリティア ～KLONDIKE～
tagline: 一枚ずつ、すっきり。いつものカードで、ひと息。
coreMechanic: Move exposed alternating descending stacks among seven tableau columns and build four suited A-to-K foundations; draw one or three cards with unlimited ordered recycling.

inputs.select: click / tap card then destination, native Tab and Enter/Space, arrow focus navigation
inputs.drag: desktop pointer drag; explicit touch drag mode; 12px threshold, cancellation clears gesture

practice: Optional six-card fixture, three actual legal moves, no save/BEST/production RUN or clears
storage: One defensive JSON session contains game_id, rule identifier, unique full 52-card state/history, seed/mode/draw/daily date, elapsed, assistance, analytics identity, reported flag and clear ledger. Audio preferences use StorageService.
jev: development-only Shadow findings; no runtime API or automated approval
humanReview: Author subjective playtest and physical devices pending; prototype publication authorized by user
telemetry: Common consent/environment services; remoteCollectionEnabled false pending parent Worker registration.
